profile.headline: Principal AI Engineer | Architecting Production-Ready Generative AI & End-to-End Agentic Systems
profile.summary: Hands-on solutions architect driven by a passion for customer satisfaction, I focus on understanding clients' needs, devising practical solutions, leading implementations, and measuring results. With experience spanning AWS and Google Cloud, I have successfully delivered solutions for the Financial, Customer Service, and Gaming industries.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
*   Architected and implemented a multi-agent system to replace a flawed web-scraping model, delivering dynamically generated, personalized content that solved critical gaps in the user experience.
*   Pioneered a systematic methodology for building complex multi-agent systems by creating a cohesive workflow with custom agent instructions and TypeScript linters. This approach enabled the reliable generation of high-quality code, moving beyond the limitations of unstructured prompting.
*   Owned the end-to-end lifecycle of a generative AI initiative, transforming a narrowly-scoped demo into a strategic business opportunity. I personally re-architected the solution, secured executive buy-in, and delivered a scalable platform for SEO and creative content that attracted new enterprise interest.
*   Addressed a critical UI/UX bottleneck by designing and implementing a dynamic front-end with a streaming data protocol. This solution drastically reduced content load times and established a new, highly responsive UX pattern that was adopted as the standard across the application.
*   Enabled the broader team to adopt advanced AI workflows by creating and sharing "AI-ready" project templates and custom agent instructions, elevating the team's capabilities and leading to more effective and data-driven development
positions.insights: Skills: Multi-agent Systems · Solution Architecture · Software Development · System Architecture · multi-cloud · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Distributed Systems · Generative AI
